title: Robinhood, MicroStrategy And Other Big Losers From Wednesday
description:
U.S. stocks closed lower on Wednesday, with the Dow Jones dipping more than 600 points. Here is the list of some big stocks recording losses in the previous session.

Chart Industries, Inc. (NYSE: GTLS) fell 35.6% to close at $154.31 after the company announced it will acquire Howden for $4.4 billion in cash and stock.
LifeStance Health Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: LFST) declined 28.9% to settle at $5.09 after the company issued Q4 and FY22 guidance below estimates.
Affirm Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: AFRM) fell 22.6% to close at $12.10 after the company reported weaker-than-expected Q1 earnings and issued FY23 sales guidance below analyst estimates.
GoodRx Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: GDRX) dropped 22.5% to close at $4.06 after the company issued Q4 sales guidance below analyst estimates.
Roblox Corporation (NYSE: RBLX) fell 21% to close at $30.92 after the company reported worse-than-expected Q3 EPS and sales results.
MicroStrategy Incorporated (NASDAQ: MSTR) dropped 19.6% to close at $170.36. Shares of several crypto-related companies traded lower following a CoinDesk report suggesting Binance is leaning toward scrapping the FTX acquisition.
